name: Lunatic Love
source:
Live alongside monsters, captivating their hearts and minds in an unforgettable romance.

Since my first night in the dorm, I’ve been plagued by relentless nightmares.

In these hazy dreams, I encounter dangerous yet thrilling monsters…

To escape this endless nightmare, I have to tame them in this way?!

A monster hunter who fails to make their first conquest will be forever trapped in a nightmare.

Which monster will become my first prey?

[From Google Play]
